title: Interactive Landing and Source Status Console
description: สร้าง full Next.js source scaffold, Landing ที่ตอบสนองต่อผู้ใช้ และหน้าสถานะ Roadmap/Handoff ที่อ่าน version metadata จาก source files.
scope: Next.js App Router, Tailwind, Drizzle/PostgreSQL schema และ Better Auth configuration boundary
Landing app registry: ESTIMETR, RCOPT, Traffic Sign, Land Acquisition V2 และ Hermes AI Agentic 24/7
Interaction preview ของ trial/read-only policy และ enterprise quotation intake form
Roadmap/Handoff HTML console ที่ refresh runtime จาก source data ทุก 15 วินาที
verification: manual responsive review of Landing and Roadmap/Handoff HTML
rollback: Return to v0.2.0-architecture; no production migration, provider credential or customer data is applied.
constraints: Pilot deploys through Vercel; production remains portable to Hostinger VPS + PostgreSQL + Cloudflare R2.
Hermes is advisory-only for takeoff evidence review and has no mutation or external communication capability.
Roadmap version files are immutable after commit; roadmap.json is the latest pointer.

items.title: Create project memory, rules, commands, hooks and handoff policy
Create versioned roadmap and commit policy
Define architecture ADRs and PostgreSQL schema
Scaffold Next.js application and Drizzle migrations
Implement membership, entitlements and ESTIMETR trial/read-only policy
Implement SVG icon system and enterprise quotation intake
Draft Hermes typed job boundary and security controls
Run security audit, tag milestone and write handoff
